# Dr. Hafiz Anwaar Ahmad Sangra — Consultant Cardiologist

> Consultant Cardiologist (MBBS, Dip. Card UHS) in Faisalabad, Pakistan. Specializing in clinical & interventional cardiology, echocardiography, angiography, hypertension, and emergency heart care with 11+ years of experience.

## Key Clinical Services
- Diagnostic Cardiology: ECG, Colour Doppler Echocardiography, Exercise Tolerance Testing (ETT), 24-hr Holter Monitoring, Calcium Scoring.
- Interventional Cardiology: Coronary Angiography, Angioplasty and Stenting.
- Cardiac Management: Heart Attack / MI, Angina Pectoris, Heart Failure, Hypertension, Dyslipidemia, Arrhythmias, Valvular & Congenital Heart Defects.
